notes:
Summary: VS Code extension vendor building a commercial IDE copilot (Editorium) used by SaaS engineering teams. Early revenue, distributed engineering org (US + EU). Want near-zero latency streaming completions and deterministic inline suggestions.

Requirements snapshot:
- Streaming completion with token-level partials in <25ms median for local keystroke flows.
- Inline suggestions with model pinning per workspace (dev wants ability to pin to a specific model hash/version).
- Auth: OAuth + SSO (SAML) for enterprise customers; per-user and per-org rate limits; token minting via backend.
- Data handling: option to disable retention for customer orgs and support EU data residency.
- Fallbacks: preferrable policy to fall back to smaller quantized model on overload.

Recent POC ask: run a 48h low-latency stream test (50 devs simulating typing bursts) in us-east and eu-west; measure median P95 latency, cold-starts, and error rates. Also test dedicated capacity pricing vs hosted for bursty dev flows.

Quotes and rep notes:
- "We need inline suggestions to feel instant — even a 50-100ms stutter breaks flow" (CTO, call 2024-12-03).
- AE notes: customer engineers will instrument telemetry hooks; wants SDK hooks for incremental tokens and cancellation.
- Concern raised by EngOps: rate-limiter behavior when multiple extensions from same org create parallel streams.

Security & procurement:
- Submitted initial security questionnaire, awaiting SOC2 artifact and KMS integration docs.
- Legal requested DPA + standard data residency commitments.

Integration details discussed:
- Suggested approach: streaming via Redwood hosted_api with optional dedicated pool for enterprise customers; prefix caching to reduce cost on common completions; model pinning exposed in extension settings and org policy.
- They prefer JWT-based backend-to-backend auth for the extension, short-lived user tokens for direct calls.

Next steps (short):
- Send detailed POC plan + test script (SE to own) — due 2024-12-22.
- Provide latency baseline report for 3 model families (ggml-like quantized, fp16, amd-optimized) — Redwood to deliver.
- Security: upload SOC2 report or provide SOC2 Readiness timeline.

POC success criteria (customer):
- P95 token latency < 150ms for incremental token delivery in EU tests.
- No more than 2% dropped streams under 200 concurrent streams.
- Inline suggestion relevancy above current baseline (internal metric) and no regressions after model pinning.
